note: Known-gap caution: 'Ahura Mazda and the Gathas' missed top-15 at corpus v27 in the frozen golden gate. Probes here anchor hard on Zarathustra/Ahura Mazda; failures reported honestly.

queries.query: Zarathustra's declaration of the two primal spirits and the choice every person must make between truth and the lie
queries.note: Yasna 30 and 45 on the twin spirits; 'hear ye with your ears', 'bright flames', 'false teacher shall not slay our life a second time' paraphrased away; 'two primal spirits' is standard comparative-religion vocabulary, Zarathustra kept as the prophet's name.

queries.query: the soul of the cow crying out to Ahura Mazda against violence and raiding, asking who was made to protect her, and receiving only the prophet Zarathustra
queries.note: Yasna 29, the Kine's complaint; 'Soul of the Kine', 'pasture-giver', 'good tillage for the fields' paraphrased away; Ahura Mazda and Zarathustra kept as names.

queries.query: how should a prophet respond when rulers and kinsmen reject his message
queries.note: Yasna 46's 'to what land shall I turn'; prophetic rejection is answered across traditions. No target — graded post-hoc.
